_meta.note: Primary sources are the ICAR institutes/AICRPs that lead research on each crop in India. Secondary sources (KVK / State Agricultural University Extension) are the local, farmer-facing channels that publish the same recommendations as regional advisories and are the best point of contact for on-ground verification before applying any treatment. Where an official institute URL could not be independently confirmed, only the institute name is given — verify via icar.org.in or your local KVK before acting on the remedy.
general_portals: ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research) - https://icar.org.in
Farmer Portal, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare - https://farmer.gov.in
Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage (DPPQS) - https://ppqs.gov.in
